profile:
COMPANY NAME: SailPoint
INDUSTRY: Identity and Access Management (IAM) / Cybersecurity
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: An adaptive identity security platform that unifies identity, data, and security intelligence to govern human, machine, and AI identities in real time.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Large enterprises, specifically Fortune 500 companies, and organizations seeking to secure agentic AI and non-human identities.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise
KEY FEATURES:
- Real-time adaptive security and continuous risk assessment across all identities.
- Governance for human, machine, and AI (non-human) identities.
- Data Access Security to govern access to sensitive data.
- Observability and insights to trace identity context and access history.
- Automated policy enforcement and least privilege management.
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- Named the "Overall Leader in identity governance" by KuppingerCole.
- 53% of the Fortune 500 are customers.
- Claims 300% ROI in 2 years and a 95% customer retention rate.
- Focus on securing the "agentic enterprise" and AI identities.
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Premium / Leader
